6 تداعكوا They contended, disputed, or litigated, one with another, vehemently. (IDrd, K.) ―
-b2- Also, (K,) or تداعكا, said of two men, (S,) They contended together, smiting one another; syn. تَمَرَّسُوا, (K,) or تَمَرَّسَا; (S;) contended, or conflicted; (IF, TA;) فِى الحَرْبِ [in war, battle, or fight]. (IF, S, K.)
From An Arabic-English Lexicon (Edward William Lane)
